recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Further wording modernization would be editorial and outside the specific applied issue unless the work group requests it separately.
issue_request: FHIR-13650 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for the DeviceKind ValueSet. It reported that the definition rendered the SNOMED CT URI as a Markdown URL, producing an unresolved link, and asked for the URI/URL presentation to be fixed.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-13650 was found. Historical commit 3032a2535b6f7d931ebbac0bc5d5a461187a3940 changed source/device/valueset-device-kind.xml from `[SNOMED CT](http://snomed.info/sct)` to `SNOMED CT (http://www.snomed.org/)`. Later commits a8227bb51b70212b4f87a34440e49ec903cd40d5 and 90089e6daab6791ce8c4081866af3904e9b644fe renamed DeviceKind to DeviceType and fixed the value set title without reintroducing the Markdown problem.
additional_context: Device remains in current build scope through source/fhir.ini, and Device.type binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-type. The current value set compose still correctly uses the SNOMED CT system URI while the description uses plain text plus a resolvable SNOMED URL. Jira neighborhood search found FHIR-9635 as background for the SNOMED CT example binding, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no FHIR-13650-specific or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch because the active source already satisfies the published issue.

related_jiras.note: Published issue that introduced the Device.type SNOMED CT example binding family later referenced by FHIR-13650.
